input.brief: Ferready reusable product-led storefront. Hardware first, cosmetics later. Red and navy brand. A tactile editorial selection table makes products directly shoppable.

direction.name: The specimen catalogue
direction.idea: Present what is on offer the way a field guide presents birds: each item alone on a flat colour, same scale, same angle, named plainly. A bakery's pastries become specimens and the specimens become the menu. A furniture maker's chairs each get their own colour tile. The format flatters ordinary objects because it treats each as worth looking at, and it replaces both the feature grid and the product-card grid with something that has a point of view.
direction.composition: Hero: a left-aligned statement of what this is (5–7vw, upper-left) beside or above a tight cluster of four to seven specimen tiles of different sizes arranged as a loose mosaic that runs off the right edge. Each tile is a flat colour square or 4:5 rectangle with one photograph centred on it, no border, 8–12px gaps. The main section is the catalogue itself: a grid of tiles in which each item has its name and one fact set beneath the tile in the text face, aligned left to the tile edge. Tile colours rotate through three or four fields from the palette. One tile in every six or seven is double size. Supporting sections (about, how to order) are plain text on the ground colour, kept short.
direction.typography: Friendly and plain. Item names at 18–22px in medium weight, facts beneath in the soft ink. One big statement in the hero; no other display type.
direction.colour: The tiles are the colour: three or four flat fields from the palette, repeated in a steady rotation. Ground stays neutral.
direction.imagery: Photographs of single items on plain backgrounds, all cropped to sit at the same apparent size within their tile. On light tiles, `mix-blend-mode: multiply` removes white studio backgrounds. If the subject's own item photographs are missing, use the dealt set and say so.
direction.richness: Rhythm of colour tiles and the pleasure of comparing like with like.
direction.pitfalls: It needs at least six items that can be shown as objects; with three it is a feature row. Keep labels outside the tiles. No shadows under the objects, no hover lift.

hero.name: Line-up on an arc
hero.blueprint: For a range: flavours, colourways, editions, sizes. One deep flat ground, which may take the current item's own colour. The current item, a cut-out photograph, stands at the exact centre about 240px wide and 450px tall (y 210–660), tilted no more than 8 degrees. Its siblings stand behind it on a shallow arc, alternately a little higher and lower: each step out is 30% smaller, a quarter darker (`filter: brightness()`) and about 260px further from the centre, three on each side, so the outermost pair is cut by the left and right edges. Under the current item, centred: its name at clamp(32px, 2.8vw, 44px) and one fact at 17px (what it tastes of, what it is made of, the price). The headline sits top-left on columns 1–4 at clamp(36px, 3.2vw, 48px) on two lines with the supporting sentence at 17px under it; the single action, a solid rectangle, sits top-right on a 32px margin. The arc is a horizontal scroller with `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`, each item snapping to the centre, its scale and brightness set from its distance to the centre, so a drag, a swipe, the arrow keys or a click on a sibling brings it forward; the ground colour follows with a 300ms transition. No arrows drawn on the screen and no counter.
hero.mobile: The current item takes 55% of the width and half the height, centred at 46% of the height; one sibling peeks in at each edge at 60% scale, half cut off. The headline sits at the top at 8vw on two lines with the supporting sentence beneath; the item's name and fact sit under the item at 24px and 16px. The action becomes a full-width button 20px above the bottom edge.
hero.headline: A plain 3–6 word line on two lines, at most 20 characters per line; the item's own name under the object changes with the selection.

motion.name: Drag row
motion.description: A row of large items wider than the screen that the visitor pulls sideways: native horizontal scrolling with scroll snapping, the first item aligned to the page margin and the last allowed to run off the edge so the row visibly continues. No carousel library, no arrows, no dots.

sections.name: Frame run, one lifted
sections.blueprint: Columns 1–3 are a nearly empty column: the heading (two to four words at 24–28px) at the top, a link under it, and one or two short notes at 15px much further down, each level with the frame it describes. Columns 4–12 hold a run of six to eight frames of the same subject at one fixed height of 30vh, with natural widths and 6px gaps: the whole view, a tight crop of the same thing, a detail, the reverse side. The run is allowed to leave the right edge. One frame is lifted out of the row: shown at 2.2 times the row height with its bottom aligned to the row's bottom (flex row, align-items: end), so it stands above the others. Under each frame, at 15px: a name on the left and a single fact on the right. Square corners, no captions on the images.
sections.mobile: The heading and link sit on top. The lifted frame comes first at full width. The rest of the run scrolls sideways beneath it at a fixed height of 34vw with 4px gaps and scroll-snap, bleeding off the right edge. Notes are listed under the run at 15px.

sections.name: Four cards dealt into a fan
sections.blueprint: Four values, rules or features, each on a card dealt onto the table as the page scrolls. A wrapper about 400svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh on the page's darkest flat ground. Each card is a portrait panel of 340×400px with a 20px radius, filled with its own palette colour (four colours that differ clearly in lightness), no border, no shadow. On a card, with 28px padding: its name at 32px in heavy capitals on one or two lines at the top, a photograph or a single picture of the thing at 60% of the card's width in the middle, and one sentence at 16px at the foot. Card one lands alone at the centre; each further quarter of the wrapper deals the next from below the bottom edge, landing 250px to the right of the one before, rotated between -4 and 4 degrees and overlapping only its right 90px, until the four form a fan about 1,090px wide centred on the stage. Keep each card's name, picture and sentence inside its left 240px, so no card ever covers another's words. In the study the cards overlap by two thirds and bury the earlier titles; here nothing lies on top of text. The heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px), sits top-left on the stage on the 32px margin with one sentence at 17px under it. The stage releases after the fourth card has settled; under reduced motion the fan is simply there.
sections.mobile: No pin. The cards sit in one row that scrolls sideways with scroll-snap, each 82% of the width with the next peeking in at the right edge, all upright. The heading and sentence sit above the row.

sections.name: Small frames, wide space
sections.blueprint: A flat, quiet viewport 100svh tall in which about 70% of the screen is empty. At mid-height a single row of small portrait frames runs across and off both sides: each frame 11vw wide and 24svh tall (roughly 2:3), spaced 5vw apart, vertically centred, six or seven visible at 1440. Frames have square corners and sit directly on the ground with no border. The row scrolls sideways by drag or trackpad (`overflow-x: auto` with the scrollbar hidden) and may hold 12–24 frames. One line of text overlaps the top-left of the first frame by 12px: a title of two or three words at 20–24px followed by the count, placed above the frame in the stacking order. Hovering a frame scales it to 1.1 from its centre over 250ms; nothing else moves. No captions under frames, no arrows, and no other text in the section.
sections.mobile: The row sits at 45% of an 80svh section. Frames are 34vw wide at 2:3 and 5vw apart, so two and a half are visible and the row scrolls by touch with snapping. The title line sits 20px above the row at the left margin.

sections.name: The action tile
sections.blueprint: The close is one row of the board. Three filled tiles sit side by side with 8–14px gaps, all 360px tall and sharing one radius: a wide centre tile spanning columns 3–10 in the accent colour, flanked by two narrow tiles (columns 1–2 and 11–12) that run off the left and right viewport edges, as if the row had been cropped from a longer one. The centre tile holds, left-aligned and vertically centred with 40px padding: a heading of three to five words at 40px, two lines at 17px, and the action. The action is either one rectangular button or an email field 420px wide in the paper colour with the submit button nested inside its right end. The flanking tiles hold no text: one is a photograph covering the tile, the other a flat palette colour. No shadows, no outlines.
sections.mobile: The accent tile runs full width, about 300px tall, heading at 28px, field and button stacked at full width. The two flanking tiles follow beneath as a pair, each half width and 120px tall, with the same gap and the same radius.

sections.name: The back of the card
sections.blueprint: The footer is the reverse side of the page's artefact, laid out as the back of a postcard. A paper-coloured panel spans columns 2–11 on the contrasting ground, about 420px tall, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops (an inline SVG path or `clip-path`, each scallop about 100px wide). The panel is divided by space into two halves. Left half: a short sign-off of two to four words at 32px, then two or three lines at 16px, written like a message. Right half: the address block, four left-aligned lines at 18px with 12px between them, each line a link (email, telephone, street, social); above it in the top-right corner, a stamp: one small photograph, 3:4 and 88px wide, with a 6px paper-coloured margin. Along the panel's bottom edge, a single centred line at 12px gives the copyright like a printer's imprint.
sections.mobile: The panel runs full width with six scallops across its top edge. The stamp sits top-right at 64px wide; the sign-off and message come first, then the address lines at 17px beneath them, then the imprint line centred at 12px.

references.name: Noho
references.idea: Furniture sold through people misusing it (wearing, balancing on, hiding behind chairs on flat colour backdrops) while the interface stays quiet beige.
references.hero: The viewport splits exactly 50/50 by tone alone: left half warm off-white, right half a slightly darker greige, no rule. Left: a small lowercase logo top-left at 30px margin, then a four-line bold headline at 60px (4.2vw), tracking -0.04em and leading near 1.0, top-left aligned and filling the upper 40%; the lower half is empty except for a one-line 18px tagline pinned bottom-left. Right: a staggered mosaic of seven portrait photos, each about 175 by 230px with 15px gaps, on a four-column, three-row grid with several cells left empty and the rightmost image cropped by the viewport edge. A white square menu button sits top-right.
references.type: Switzer only. Headlines weight 600, tracking -0.04em, sentence case, charcoal rather than black; statements at 60px, body 13.5px, meta labels about 11px grey. The digest records one element at 15.6vw. Roughly four sizes, one family, no caps.
references.colour: #f1eee9 #e7e2dc #cdc0b0 #3c3c3c #b4a5db #f2e05a — The interface is three close warm beiges with charcoal type; saturated colour (lilac, yellow, olive, terracotta, sand) exists only in photo backdrops and the products themselves.
references.imagery: Studio shots of people interacting oddly with chairs on seamless single-colour backdrops, portrait 3:4, square corners; plus very large cut-out product shots on beige with a soft radial glow and contact shadow, cropped by the panel edge.
references.layout: Outer margins of 16-30px. Sections alternate between split halves, centred statements and left-aligned headings over card rows. Cards are flat rectangles one tone darker than the page with 8px gaps, content pinned to the top-left and bottom edges. Wide empty bands separate sections.

sections.description: A centred four-line statement at about 60px bold with tiny square photo thumbnails, roughly one cap-height tall, dropped inline between words like emoji. Directly beneath, the page splits into two full-width flat colour halves (light greige and tan), each with a small circled plus button in its top inner corner; these are the tops of the two product panels.

Two side-by-side panels in different beiges, each dominated by one enormous cut-out chair (one yellow, one black) cropped at the top so mostly seat and legs show, with a soft radial highlight behind. Along the bottom of each panel: a tiny label and price at left, a row of colour-swatch dots, then two small rectangular buttons at right, one white and one charcoal.

Three equal flat tiles in a row with 8px gaps, each about 210px tall. One short claim is centred in each at roughly 18px, and an index number sits alone in the bottom-left corner in 11px. A small bulleted label hangs above each tile. After a large empty gap, another centred bold statement begins.

A horizontal strip of colour-backdrop photos bleeds off both edges at the top of the section. Below, a left-aligned bold heading at about 40px, then a row of beige cards overflowing to the right: each has an @name at top-left, a short paragraph in 11px, and a bottom row with star glyphs left and a small text link right.

steal: Split the hero 50/50 by background tone alone, park the headline top-left and one tagline bottom-left, and fill the other half with a staggered photo mosaic that leaves grid cells empty.
Keep the interface in three close beige tones and confine all saturated colour to photo backdrops and products, so the photography becomes the palette.
Drop cap-height photo thumbnails inline between the words of a large centred statement.
references.media: A stepped mosaic of seven 175x231 studio photographs (people doing odd things with a chair against one saturated backdrop each) covers about 22% of the fold on the darker right half, bleeding off the right edge; the left half is type. Below come photo chips between the words of a statement, two product halves each with a live 3D chair on its own tone, an auto-scrolling row of portrait tiles, a pinned card deck, and a sticky 3D chair card beside an accordion; square corners everywhere, no video.
references.motion: About 1s of entrance with no preloader: headline lines rise through masks while the mosaic tiles arrive one by one. Lenis holds sticky product halves and pins a story deck for +=400% (3600px), each step bringing the next card in from the right and compressing earlier ones into slivers, and the footer is uncovered by a scrubbed mask over a 728px runway as its slogan letters rise over 1.04s at a 0.04s stagger; micro-interactions are GSAP nudges of 0.2-0.4s on custom eases, and the 3D chairs turn on drag.

references.name: Humanoid Index
references.idea: A catalogue of humanoid robots as a single-screen instrument: spin a wheel of names and one specimen appears on a plain card, ready to compare.
references.hero: A white, app-like screen with no headline. Top centre: a small segmented pill control with three categories and grey counts. Dead centre: a pale-grey rounded card about 400 by 455px holding one cut-out robot; above its top-left, a tiny maker logo with name, year and company at 13px; below it, a pill toolbar of four line icons. To its right, a paler empty card with a plus button labelled 'Compare'. Left of the card, a vertical wheel of robot names: the selected one black at 20px, the rest shrinking, fading and tilting along an arc. At the far left, mid-height: a logo glyph, a grid toggle and two credit lines.
references.type: Geist Sans Regular only, between 12 and 20px with -0.04em tracking. Hierarchy comes from grey value and opacity rather than size or weight; the selected name at 20px is the largest text on the page. No display type at all.
references.colour: #ffffff #f9f9f9 #1c1c1c #9b9b9b #f1b80e — White page, off-white cards, black and grey text. All colour arrives through the robots themselves, such as one yellow model.
references.imagery: Cut-out product shots and renders of robots, full figure, centred with even padding on identical off-white rounded cards, held at one scale and stance so models compare like specimens. A grey two-blob skeleton shows while loading.
references.layout: One fixed viewport with no sections: centred card, compare slot to its right, name wheel to its left, controls parked at top centre and far left. Roughly 60% of the screen is empty white. Scrolling changes the selection, not the position.

sections.description: The index is a wheel picker rather than a grid: about nine names are stacked vertically to the left of the card, right-aligned on a shallow arc. The active name is full black at 20px; neighbours step down in size, fade to light grey and tilt progressively, as if on a drum. Scrolling rotates the drum and swaps the card image, and the line above the card updates with the maker's logo, year and company.

On mobile the layout becomes a horizontal card carousel: a white rounded card nearly the full viewport tall holds the robot, the next card peeks about 30px at the right, and a bottom sheet with a drag handle carries a maker icon, the model name at about 28px with the year in grey beside it, the company beneath and a position counter right-aligned.

steal: Replace a thumbnail grid with a vertical wheel of names whose items shrink, fade and tilt away from the selection.
Hold every catalogue item at the same scale and stance on an identical off-white card so differences read instantly.
Keep all text between 12 and 20px and build hierarchy from grey values, leaving the object as the only large thing on screen.

references.name: Aardvark Book Club
references.idea: A book club dressed as a sweet shop: fat black type, tumbling 3D books and boxes on wavy colour fields, annotated with handwritten asides.
references.hero: A saturated yellow field with two large wavy blobs, pale yellow then orange, rising from the bottom. A three-line headline in Champ Bold, black, at about 8.3vw with leading under 0.85, is flush to a 15px left margin and reaches 60% across. Beneath it: a four-line paragraph 310px wide and a magenta split button (label plus arrow square). Right of centre a 3D hardback in navy and pink tilts 20 degrees, 600px tall; another book is cropped by the top-left corner, a third by the bottom edge. A purple handwritten note sits rotated at far right. Nav: pale-yellow pill links centred, an orange login button, black round social icons.
references.type: Champ Bold, an ultra-heavy wide sans with a looped g, for headings at 120px with tight tracking and leading; Degular for 18px body and pill labels; a purple handwritten script (Hello Organichand) for rotated margin notes and step labels. Three distinct voices.
references.colour: #ffd249 #faed8f #f9a21f #ffdbfd #a4f6f8 #fd48f2 — Each section owns one flat candy colour: yellow hero, white shelf, pink steps, cyan unboxing, deep violet footer. Type stays black; buttons are magenta.
references.imagery: 3D-rendered hardbacks and a patterned shipping box, cut out and tilted, floating over flat wavy vector shapes; real book covers on tilted coloured cards; black line drawings of figures on step cards. Nothing sits square to the grid.
references.layout: Sections are full-width panels with roughly 80px corner radius inset about 20px from the viewport, each a different colour. Headings alternate left and centre; cards overlap and rotate a few degrees; handwritten notes are tucked beside headings at an angle.

sections.description: White band. A centred black heading at 5.5vw over a two-line subline, with a rotated handwritten note at its upper left. Below, a horizontal row of book covers, each on a rounded colour-matched card with a small tag pill at top-left; cards tilt alternately by 3 degrees at staggered heights, the last cropped by the right edge, with two round arrow buttons above at right. Later, covers give way to same-coloured info cards with genre pills, heavy title and blurb.

A pale-pink rounded panel with lighter wavy shapes inside. Heavy black heading at left with a handwritten aside beside it; a small round logo stamp and a magenta split button at right. Along the bottom, four portrait cards about 250px wide in cyan, magenta, yellow and violet overlap like a fanned hand, each rotated a few degrees, with a handwritten step label at top, a black line drawing in the middle and a heavy caption at the foot.

A full-viewport cyan rounded panel containing only a 3D shipping box wrapped in a wavy magenta, violet and black pattern, centred. Across the scroll it goes from closed and tilted to lid open, growing to about 57% of the viewport width, with a single handwritten note at its right. No heading and no button.

The preceding white section ends in large rounded bottom corners over a deep violet footer. Left: white logo, two store badges, two magenta round social icons. Centre: the patterned box again, cropped by the bottom edge. Right: a small heavy heading, a white rounded email field and a magenta split button. A black legal strip closes the page.

steal: Give each section one flat saturated colour inside a large-radius inset panel and keep the type black across all of them.
Add rotated handwritten margin notes beside headings to carry secondary facts in a second voice.
Fan step cards so they overlap and tilt instead of sitting in an even grid.
references.media: About 60% of the first screen is picture: a 3D book and cropped book corners over a full-bleed illustrated wave field. Below come a sticky image-sequence of a box opening inside a rounded panel, a slider of tilted cards bleeding off the right edge, covers fanned like a hand of cards, a sticker collage round a circular badge and a cut-out box rising out of the footer: 37 images and two scroll-scrubbed canvases, no video.
references.motion: An indigo transition panel wipes away by 1.2s while the headline arrives word by word (515 split characters), and Lenis then drives the scrubbed scenes: the hero book turns through an image sequence, a sticky stage scrubs the box opening over 2745px, a headline slides along a curved path at scrub 0.5, and the footer is uncovered from under the rounded page. Buttons squash to 0.955 by 0.925 in 0.15s on press, the main ease is cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), and the bounce overshoots are ones the house motion layer does not use, though the site ships 32 reduced-motion rules.
